transcript: Do you know that if you're trying to love yourself, you already do? The very act of trying is proof. A tree does not force itself to grow. It simply reaches toward the light. And you, by seeking healing, peace or self-love, are already reaching toward yours. Do not be discouraged because the journey feels slow. Mountains are not climbed in a single step. Some days you will feel strong. Some days you will feel lost. Some days old wounds will return and ask to be felt again. This is not failure. This is the path. Many people believe self-love is a destination. It is not. It is a practice, a quiet promise you make to yourself each day. To keep showing up. To keep learning. To keep forgiving. To keep growing. Even when life changes. Even when the world becomes uncertain. Even when there seems to be no reason to smile. You will find a way. Because peace was never something outside of you. It has always been waiting within. So be patient with yourself. And remember, if you are trying to love yourself, you already do. The fact that you are still trying is proof. And that is a beautiful thing. Comment healing if you are not where you want to be yet. But you haven't given up.
